name: 梵蒂冈
summary: 梵蒂冈城国政府的官方机构入口；本站尚未确认面向普通申请人的公开移民申请渠道，具体资格、文件、费用和办理时间亦未复核。
summaryEn: Official institutional entry point for the Government of Vatican City State; no public immigration application channel for ordinary applicants has been confirmed here, and eligibility, documents, fees, and timing have not been reviewed.
